_doc: BREBBIA dating cabinet (#22, built 2026-07-18 — Wave B). One clean cliff does the work: 1968, when the MPB (Manifattura Pipe Brebbia) logo gave way to the gold-outlined DIAMOND and the brand became simply 'Brebbia'. Before that: gnome stem logo (1953-56, variant outline to 1968). Company story: 1947 Enea Buzzi + Achille Savinelli joint firm (pipes = SAVINELLI-branded); 1953 split — Buzzi keeps the factory; MPB brand created 1953 (pipephil) / formally set up 1956-06-22 after the buyout (monjureinternational) -> start encoded 1953 = earliest plausible, conflict noted; 1968 logo cliff; 1990s Luciano Buzzi (son) manages. SOURCES: staging/pipedia/Brebbia.json + pipephil logo-brebbia mirror (stamp authority) + monjureinternational.com corroboration — extract in brand_research/brebbia_dating/. TRAP: line 'Serie 1960' carries a year in its NAME — never a manufacture year (perception must not feed it to stamped_year).

history_anchors._doc: 1947 Enea Buzzi + Achille Savinelli found the joint firm at Bosco Grosso di Brebbia (Varese) — output sold under the SAVINELLI name (exclusive to 1953, name rights ran out 1956). 1953 split: Savinelli builds his own plant at Barasso; Buzzi keeps the Brebbia factory; MPB brand born (1953 per pipephil / 1956-06-22 formal buyout per monjure). 1968: logo changes MPB -> simple gold-outlined diamond, brand = 'Brebbia' (slow-smoking-competition era). 1990s+: Luciano Buzzi manages. Seconds: Cellini (script-B stem logo), Jceberg/Iceberg, Jumbo, Vincenzo Lombardi. Rainer Barbi designed a 'Barbi Design' line (undated). Corsellini (Firenze) relation = open question. Modern: 9mm filter pipes for northern Europe, some with VAUEN's Konex system.

brand_marks.physical: Pre-1968: 'M.P.B.' in the stamp (diamond with MPB letters), gnome stem logo (original 1953-56; slightly different outline 1956-68). Post-1968: gold-outlined diamond stem logo, brand word 'Brebbia' alone. Script 'B' stem logo = destined for the Cellini seconds line. Enea Buzzi signature on Collection pipes. ⚠️ 'Serie 1960' = a LINE NAME, not a year.

line_years._notes: No line has documented intro/end years in our sources -> nothing encoded (honesty rule: thin/unknown line years stay out). Parked names: golden gnome, sun, pura (+diagonale), amaranto, rubino serie 83, gioia, golden natural, silver star, lido, lord, nikotex, linea roma, collection, serie 1960 (TRAP: name contains a year), barbi design (Rainer Barbi collaboration, undated). Seconds (separate stamps, route here for era logic only): cellini, jceberg, jumbo, vincenzo lombardi.

table.label: MPB stamp = pre-cliff era (diamond replaced it 1968; start 1953-pipephil vs 1956-monjure). ⚠️ TRAP (2016 company catalogue, mined 2026-07-17): the M.P.B. logo was REVIVED ~2008 for Vintage/silver-ferrule/pipe-of-the-year lines — a modern-construction MPB (acrylic stem, Ag-925 ferrule, 4-digit modern shapes, 'Museum Series') = 2008+, NOT pre-1968. Confidence dropped HIGH->MEDIUM for the trap; corroborate with gnome/diamond + construction
gnome stem logo: original 1953-1956 (pipephil), variant outline documented 1956-1968 -> wide honest 1953-1968
